title: RuneScape 4 is real: Jagex reveals new MMO RS4 🐉
subject: runescape
description:
Would you play a new RuneScape MMO? 👇

Jagex revealed RS4, a new RuneScape MMO built in Unreal Engine, at RuneFest 2026 in Birmingham on October 3. RS4 began as an expansion for RuneScape: Dragonwilds, is set after its events starting in Ashenfall, and is still a few years away.

Sources: Jagex via Gematsu (Oct 3, 2026), PC Gamer, Well Played
Game footage © Jagex.

scenes.text: Jagex just announced a brand-new RuneScape MMO.
It's called RS4, revealed at RuneFest on October 3, and it's built in Unreal Engine.
It started as an expansion for the survival game RuneScape: Dragonwilds, until the team realized it deserved to be a full MMO.
It's set years after Dragonwilds, starting in Ashenfall, and the teaser shows dragons and floating islands.
